market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by widespread consolidation and drying volume across all major assets. While broader session trends remain firmly bearish beneath downward-sloping VWAP and EMA50 baselines, low RVOL (< 1.2 across the board) and compression into key structural boundaries mandate patience. XAUUSD is pinned directly against Put Wall #1, US100 is compressed between Call Wall #1 and the Gamma Flip in a dampening regime, and BTCUSD is range-bound inside fair value around its session Point of Control.

signals.rationale: 1) VP context: Price is below VAL (3875.39) and below POC (3882.58). 2) CVD: BEARISH at -4.98, though short-term slope is fading (+0.52). 3) Session: NEW_YORK_SESSION late phase. 4) Trend: Price (3873.11) is tracking firmly below downward-sloping VWAP (3891.90) and below EMA50 (3885.53). 5) ATR: Consolidating near the lower ATR band (3867.28). 6) RVOL: 0.695, indicating absence of breakout volume. 7) S/R & GEX: GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (4013.37). Price is resting directly on Put Wall #1 (3874.86) and S/R support (3872.05). Selling directly into Put Wall #1 without scalp room to Session Low (3867.64) violates GEX rules, while buying counters negative gamma trend.
signals.level_event: rejection at Put Wall #1 and S/R
